query: Identify the core sentiment-bearing phrases in Instance A (e.g., 'worst', 'corny', 'predictable', 'cheap', 'clichés') versus Instance B (e.g., 'top Hindi comedies', 'effortless', 'hilarious', 'impeccable', 'witty').
